data.one_liner: Android implementation of the google_maps_flutter plugin.
data.what_it_does: Provides the Android-specific platform implementation for the google_maps_flutter plugin. It handles rendering Google Maps on Android using either Texture Layer Hybrid Composition or Hybrid Composition.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app for Android using google_maps_flutter and need to configure Android-specific map settings.
You need to explicitly force Hybrid Composition or texture layer settings for Android map rendering.
avoid_when: You are writing a cross-platform app and only need to depend on the high-level google_maps_flutter package directly instead of the Android implementation.
strengths: Federated plugin architecture cleanly separates Android-specific implementation details.
Supports performance tuning via display mode configurations and SDK warmup APIs.
weaknesses: Platform-specific to Android; requires corresponding iOS implementations for cross-platform apps.
data.setup_notes: Specify your Google Maps API key in the application manifest android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml.

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: The main endorsed federated wrapper package that includes this Android implementation automatically.
